A Must-Visit in Hanoi for Incredible Food and Value!
Jul 2026 • Family
Finding a restaurant that hits the mark on flavor, price, and service can be tricky, especially when traveling with a hungry family of five, but Mr. Bay Mien Tay completely delivered. We stopped here during our time in Hanoi, and it was easily one of our favorite meals of the entire trip.
The food was absolutely delicious; everything tasted incredibly fresh and authentic. Beyond the amazing flavors, the prices are fantastic and offer such great value. What really made the experience special, though, was the staff. They were wonderfully warm, welcoming, and attentive to our family the entire time. If you want a fantastic, stress-free meal in Hanoi, I can't recommend this place enough!

Authentic and interesting experience
Feb 2026 • Couples
An authentic Vietnamese experience. Always a queue so pick your time carefully. We walked past several times, and early lunch seemed the best option! Evening, the queue was round the corner. 

Great to watch the pancakes being cooked at the entrance as you wait in the queue. It is not just pancakes on offer, although these do seem the most popular dish. Great social event to meet lots of people in the queue….an unintended benefit of queuing.

We are no experts on local cuisine but wanted to savor the experience as much as the food.

A memorable bánh xèo experience
Feb 2026 • Couples
Wanting to branch out and try something different from the usual dishes in Hanoi, we headed to Mr. Bay Miền Tây for a Southern-style bánh xèo — and it did not disappoint.

We ordered a chicken bánh xèo, pork skewers with mint, and fresh spring rolls. The bánh xèo was outstanding: perfectly crispy and packed with flavor. A generous basket of herbs and leaves was also brought to the table, allowing us to assemble our own rolls with rice paper — a fun and authentic touch.

Beyond the food, the service was excellent — fast, attentive, and welcoming.

All the elements were there for a truly enjoyable meal.

Crepes were delicious
Oct 2025 • Couples
We really liked this place. Bank Xeo is something we have never tried so it was great to try this place. They have other items in their menu as well like pho, spring rolls etc and it's an actual sit in restaurant with 2 floors and air conditioning upstairs. We ordered their speciality which wa the crepes. It's egg mixes in with some rice flour and driesd in a big wok very thinly and they add some meat and bean sprouts fold it like a huge omelet and they cut it up crosswise. You are given some rice paper, lay some lettuce and herbs on top then the omelet and put some fish sauce and chillies and then wrap it like a spring roll and chow down. One order is food for 2 people but I would add some spring rolls.
Written October 10, 2025
